The '''Korfo system''' was situated in the [[Arrowhead]], [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was located on the [[Commenor Run/Legends|Commenor Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Cirius system/Legends|Cirius]] and [[Tepasi system/Legends|Tepasi systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] contained the astronomical object [[Korfo II/Legends|Korfo II]].<ref name="GG4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Korfo system was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine/ The article placed the system in the "Imperial Core" [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The canonical existence of the Korfo system was subsequently established by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" />
